topics.title: Pluggable backend architecture
topics.summary: Jared presented the pull request and design document for a pluggable backend architecture. The notes describe adding the interface first as a pull request and wiring existing code to it later as the community adopts it. They call for an inventory of everything related to PyArrow (FileIO, scan planning, table operations), asking why there are PyArrow calls outside pyarrow.py, so that a later switch to DataFusion shows a 1:1 mapping. The steps noted are: move all PyArrow code into pyarrow.py, then look for an abstraction across Polars, DataFusion and PyArrow, referring to Java. The notes add not to try to work out user use cases (for example data sizes that may run out of memory); the UX lets people use whatever public API is available.
open_questions: Where is PyArrow used across the code base, and why are there PyArrow calls outside pyarrow.py?
Once the PyArrow code is in one place, what abstraction would cover Polars, DataFusion and PyArrow?
